articles.title: Meta's Muse AI promises to change your life - if it can access your most valuable data | BBC News
articles.titleZh: Meta的Muse AI承诺将改变您的生活——前提是它能够访问您最宝贵的数据 | BBC新闻
articles.summary:
It can pay your bills, plan your holidays and order your groceries - if you give access to the deepest corners of your life. 
 
Meta's AI agent, Muse, has launched in the UK. The personal assistant has become one of the most downloaded apps in the US with many claiming it has brought order to their chaotic lives. 
 
But what's the trade off? 
 
We look at how Muse works, why the parent company for WhatsApp and Instagram is investing big in the tech and explore whether its ambitions are a step too far into people's privacy.
 
00:00 – Meta’s AI agent Muse hits the UK
01:19 – How does it work?
02:28 – How much does it cost?
03:24 – What’s different about it?
04:48 – Is my data safe?
06:09 – What happens if it goes rogue?
07:42 – Why is Muse being rolled out?
08:37 – Are even more advanced AI agents being developed?
09:39 – How is Meta doing against rivals in the AI race?

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

#Meta #AI #BBCNews

articles.readingText:
It can pay your bills, plan your holidays and order your groceries - if you give access to the deepest corners of your life.

Meta's AI agent, Muse, has launched in the UK.

The personal assistant has become one of the most downloaded apps in the US with many claiming it has brought order to their chaotic lives.

But what's the trade off?

We look at how Muse works, why the parent company for WhatsApp and Instagram is investing big in the tech and explore whether its ambitions are a step too far into people's privacy.

它可以帮您支付账单、规划假期和订购生鲜杂货——前提是您允许它触及您生活的方方面面。

articles.title: Huang's return 'a gift from above' for Dems: Enten & panel unpack
articles.titleZh: 黄的回归对民主党来说是“上天的恩赐”：Enten和专家组解读
articles.summary:
CNN chief data analyst Harry Enten points out that American voters 'think that this is a rigged economy' and that President Trump ignored the clear message from voters in the 2026 midterm elections. Noting that voters trust Democrats on the issues of AI and corruption by double digits more than Republicans, Enten goes on to say that "Donald Trump essentially gave a giant middle finger to the American people" when he worked to have Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia's CEO.

Also, the "NewsNight" panel discusses Huang's return.

0:00 Is there a different set of rules for billionaires than the rest of us?
0:20 Enten: "Am I on planet Mars here? What the hell is going on?"

articles.readingText:
CNN chief data analyst Harry Enten points out that American voters 'think that this is a rigged economy' and that President Trump ignored the clear message from voters in the 2026 midterm elections.

Noting that voters trust Democrats on the issues of AI and corruption by double digits more than Republicans, Enten goes on to say that "Donald Trump essentially gave a giant middle finger to the American people" when he worked to have Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia's CEO.

Also, the "NewsNight" panel discusses Huang's return.
articles.readingTextZh:
CNN首席数据分析师哈里·恩滕（Harry Enten）指出，美国选民“认为这是一个被操纵的经济体”，而特朗普总统无视了选民在2026年中期选举中发出的明确信息。

恩滕指出，在人工智能和腐败问题上，选民对民主党的信任度比对共和党的信任度高出两位数。他接着说，当唐纳德·特朗普努力让黄仁勋重返英伟达首席执行官职位时，“他实际上是对美国人民竖起了中指”。

此外，“NewsNight”节目组也讨论了黄的回归。
